caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, wooden mechanical object, composed of two main stacked sections, both with carved panel detailing and dark brown coloration. The upper section features a large circular opening in the center, bordered by a frame, containing a series of vertical blue and yellow striped tubes or pipes. On the right side of this section, there is a yellow crank handle protruding outward. The lower section is larger, serving as the base, and has a rectangular panel on the front. Between the upper and lower sections, there are several small, round, white buttons or knobs lined up horizontally. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with a thin, faint rectangular border surrounding the entire composition.
title: Cylinder Pipe Organ
